content: GitHub Copilot SDK is GA as of 2026-06-02; multi-language (Python, TS, Go, Rust, Java, .NET). Python package github-copilot-sdk v1.0.2 (2026-06-18), requires Python 3.11+, async, communicates via JSON-RPC with the Copilot CLI runtime (CLI in server mode). CopilotClient/create_session/send. Custom tools via @define_tool with Pydantic schemas; MCP via mcpServers in SessionConfig; custom agents via customAgents; BYOK supported; optional OpenTelemetry telemetry extra.
